summary: Provider families in the UI: Local model, Claude, ChatGPT, Spotify, Browser (+ Other). A 'Providers at a glance' panel lists each way of reaching a provider separately: Provider API, Website, App launch, On this device, Not available. Each row has its own status from the existing service views. A Provider filter works together with the existing method filter.

Spotify app-launch route: 'Start the Spotify app' sends {type:'launch', target:'Spotify.exe'} through the existing previewAction/executeAction approval flow. The real preview shows whether Spotify.exe is in Approved apps and exists; nothing starts without approval. The UI says this is not an account connection.

Stale states: a session check result counts as connected/check-failed only while it is current. It is out of date after checkMaxAgeMs (default 30 min) or once the checked origin changes (for example a new local endpoint in Settings). The state then goes back to ready-to-check and lastCheck is kept as history. The UI shows an 'out of date, check again' warning, a Refresh status button and the time the status was read. A failed reload keeps the last statuses and marks them as possibly out of date.

Local check errors: a refused or timed-out loopback request now says 'Ollama is not answering at <origin>', with a start-Ollama / check-Settings hint instead of the internet/VPN hint. Provider APIs keep the network hint.

Selected-model detection (optional dep localModel): the Ollama check detail says whether the model chosen in Settings is installed. A bare name matches the ':latest' tag. The model list is parsed defensively: 1 MB cap, names only, control characters dropped.

Strict local URL validation: the new exported checkLocalEndpoint accepts only http on 127.0.0.0/8, ::1 or localhost. It rejects credentials, paths, queries, fragments, backslashes, whitespace and lookalike hosts. resolveCheckOrigin uses it, so an unsafe endpoint blocks the check before any request. A throwing Settings getter is reported, not crashed on.
unchangedGuarantees: Offline is still the default. list/view/preview never fetch or confirm (tested in both modes). Provider APIs are blocked offline without a prompt.
Every online check still needs the user's opt-in, online mode, their own key and the trusted main-process confirm (Cancel default). A declined confirmation sends nothing.
Website handoffs and setup-required connectors (claude-web, chatgpt-web, spotify-web, browser, spotify-api) can never be checked, keyed, turned on or reach 'connected'.
No OAuth, account access, client secrets, new origins or automatic cloud calls were added. netGuard and the catalog are unchanged.

checks.command: npm run build (typecheck + vite build + scripts/build-main.mjs)

interfaceProposals.proposal: Pass localModel: () => settings.model (the Ollama model name already in Settings) to createIntegrationService so the local check can report whether the selected model is installed. Optional and backwards compatible; until it is wired, the detail text stays as before.

Optional: add a 'stale' ConnectionState, or a lastCheck 'current: boolean' flag, to IntegrationView. The service currently reports out-of-date results as 'ready-to-check' with lastCheck kept, and the UI infers 'out of date'. A dedicated state would make that explicit for other consumers such as Home.

Optional: reuse svc.checkLocalEndpoint in validateLocalEndpoint (validation.ts). It currently strips paths and queries silently instead of rejecting them, so the Settings field would show the same reason the check does.

limitations: No real provider, Ollama or Spotify was contacted. All network, keys, prefs and confirmations in tests are injected mocks. The Spotify app-launch button depends on the existing launch action and the Approved apps list; it was checked only by static render, not by clicking it in a running Electron window.

The UI tests use renderToStaticMarkup only. The interactive approve/cancel flow of the app-launch control reuses the existing ApprovedLink component, which this slice did not test again in an interactive renderer.

Staleness covers age and origin changes. A mode switch is already handled by the 'offline' state. A key replaced outside this service (for example via Settings' cloud key) relies on the existing onKeyChange/refresh path.
ChatGPT chat routing is still not built; only the OpenAI connection check exists, and the UI says so. Spotify playback/OAuth remains setup-required with no sign-in.
